methodology: Ranked by hotness_score = today_stars(0.4) + growth_rate(0.3) + recency(0.15) + base_stars(0.15)

ai_emerging_top10.description: Source control for agents. Use multiple coding agents, track their changes and query them in one place
ai_emerging_top10.about: Source control for agents. Use multiple coding agents, track their changes and query them in one place
ai_emerging_top10.readme_highlight: Atlas is source control for coding agents. Every agent run produces checkpoints: commits are linked back to the session that made it alongside the prompts, tool calls, and reasoning. You see which agent did exactly what and why.
